# Parts diagrams (Engine Bay)

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Identify throttle routing, locate distributor cap, spark plugs, brake components, clutch master cylinder, intake system, battery, fuses, O2 sensors, power steering pump, fan assembly, thermostat housing, AC belt idler, and tweak belts. [t1091]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Identify the throttle routing in the engine bay.
2. [Partial] Locate the distributor cap and rotor.
3. [Partial] Find the spark plugs on the right side of the engine (Bank 1).
4. [Partial] Examine the spark plugs on the left side of the engine (Bank 2).
5. [Partial] Inspect the brake components near the firewall.
6. Check other parts located in that same area, such as the AC evaporator core.
7. [Partial] Locate the clutch master cylinder if equipped with a manual transmission.
8. [Partial] Trace the intake system from the air filter housing forward.
9. [Partial] Find the component situated just below or in front of the air filter box.
10. Identify the battery and its associated engine fuses.
11. [Partial] Look behind the fuse area for additional components like O2 sensor connectors.
12. [Partial] Locate the power steering pump mounted on the side.
13. [Partial] Find the fan assembly at the rear of the engine block.
14. [Partial] Check the coolant thermostat housing near the front.
15. Adjust the AC belt idler pulley if necessary.
16. [Partial] Tweak the power steering, water pump, and fan belt idler pulleys.

_Procedure reported by [t1091]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/xterra-101-engine-bay-pictorial.3417/>_
